name: reminder
description: Schedules reminders. Send a message with delay and text, it will publish the reminder when the time comes. Survives restarts via persistent state.

default_subscriptions.description: Schedule a reminder. Payload: {delay: "<duration>", text: "<message>"}; fires on reminder.fire when due.
Periodic wake from the clock node so due reminders can fire even when no reminder.set arrives.
